title: sqliteInput
responsibility: Builds ordered, SQLite-ready column and binding pairs from a partial model input.

inputs.name: sqliteInput.model
inputs.description: The table model declaring valid application properties, column names and field types.

inputs.name: sqliteInput.input
inputs.description: The partial record keyed by model property; keys missing from the model are rejected.

outputs.name: sqliteInput
outputs.description: One quoted database column and normalized SQLite binding for each input property, preserving input order.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Raised for a property not declared by the model or a value that cannot be bound.
